about.beforeAfter: Make ideas tangible with before-and-vision images
about.creatorsText: Local artists can suggest colour, light, art and new expressions for the city's spaces.
about.ctaText: Start by exploring what others have seen, or share your own vision.
about.findText: Discover streets, squares, parks and other places with potential.
about.howText: Stadslyft is built to make it easy to go from an idea to real urban change – step by step together with your neighbors and municipality.
about.howTitle: From idea to completed city lift.
about.intro: Stadslyft makes it easy to turn frustration into proposals. Residents and local artists can share ideas about our common places and make them visible, concrete and actionable.
about.localArtists: Invite local artists and creators to contribute creative visions
about.localPerspectives: Share local perspectives and discover projects near you
about.mattersText: Vote, comment and build on ideas together.
about.observationText: An unsafe walkway, an empty square, or a blank concrete wall affects daily life more than we think. Together, we make the city's potential visible.
about.potentialText: Discover streets, squares, parks and other places with potential.
about.signals: Clear timeline and progress tracking from idea to completion
about.step1Text: Use the interactive map or 'Near Me' to discover locations in your neighborhood with untapped potential.
about.step2Text: Share clear before-and-after imagery. Invite collaborators and local creators to make the vision even stronger.
about.step3Text: Gather votes, hypes, and discuss ideas live with neighbors. Easily share proposals with your local community.
about.step4Text: Track the proposal's journey in real-time: from Idea to Municipal review, Planning, and finally Completed project.
about.supportText: Vote, comment and build on ideas together.
about.title: The city belongs to everyone who lives in it.
about.visionText: Describe what could be better and show how the place could look.
about.whyText: An unsafe passage, an empty square or a grey concrete wall affects everyday life more than we may realize. Stadslyft brings local knowledge and creativity together where they belong: with the people who use these places and the local artists who can give them new life.
about.whyTitle: Small changes can make a big difference.
